play_plan.meaning: Qualifying: the engineer tells the driver very few cars are still out on track (thin traffic, clear window for a lap).
play_plan.when_it_should_play: SessionType 5 (qualifying), team channel (no driver), while 1-5 cars are on track. Once per qualifying session.
play_plan.trigger: SESSION_TYPE *(int*)0x007C56A4 == 5 (FACT, AICornerSpeedComparison_00419500.c:10 and traffic_density_commentary.c:63). Count = slots s in 0..103 with *(int*)(0x5EC6D8 + s*0x48C0 + 0x32C8) != -1 AND *(int*)(same + 0x3450) == 0 (traffic_density_commentary.c:134-143; OFF_ACTIVE FACT, OFF_PITTING CONFIRMED live 2026-07-28). Band few = 1..5. Fire needs COMMENTARY_ON *(0x5EA618+0xAF0) != 0, RACE_PHASE *(0x7C56A8) > 4, TRACK_COND *(0x7CF3C8) != 0.0 (:213-221), and EVENT_TABLE[12]+0x0C < FLT_MAX.

play_plan.technique: own_emitter (no native emitter to lift; the mod queues PWS eid 12 by raw queue write)
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per band per qualifying session (fired_band latch); 60 s minimum gap between any two fires (COOLDOWN_MS 60000); latch resets on leaving qualifying
play_plan.must_not_play_when: SessionType != 5; count == 0 (session ending or not started, mod comment near :141); cars in pit or garage (pittingStatus 4) must not count; cooldown FLT_MAX; pending fire is aborted when qualifying ends
play_plan.conflicts: No native emitter, so no native clash. Dump score 10 is shared with TV eid 303 (score-picked queue): do not use 303. Eid 12 is also a driver-name id in DriverNameIDLookup (line 364), not emitted, no clash today. MF tokens use 10 and 16, not 12 (census). Rule (DD-07, AUDIT_BRIEF coordinator rule b): do not queue eid 12 while an MF line is pending on that eid (none in census). Trigger is a car count, so rules (a) ahead/behind and (c) lap phase are not applicable. Quirk: when COMMENTARY_ON is 0 the band is latched and lost (traffic_density_commentary.c:216).
